thread.title: [SPOILER ALERT] Special Participation A: Claude on HW13
thread.content: <document version="2.0"><file url="https://static.us.edusercontent.com/files/pKF3cCeevXJq5RmHC9p1JDjT" filename="Claude HW13 output.pdf"/><paragraph>In this chat, I used Claude 4.5 Sonnet to answer HW13. My prompt is included in the pdf. Overall Claude was able to do pretty well, answering all subproblems fully correctly (in my opinion). This was all one single try. Claude is able to do the first parts of each question very well and provides a very good explanation for each. I'm overall extremely impressed with some of the more complicated problems, such as in part 2b where it shows most of the (lengthy) derivation by minimizing KL. There are some small parts where it skipped intermediate algebraic derivation steps like in 2b for the Lagrange multipliers but overall the performance was quite strong.</paragraph></document>
thread.document: In this chat, I used Claude 4.5 Sonnet to answer HW13. My prompt is included in the pdf. Overall Claude was able to do pretty well, answering all subproblems fully correctly (in my opinion). This was all one single try. Claude is able to do the first parts of each question very well and provides a very good explanation for each. I'm overall extremely impressed with some of the more complicated problems, such as in part 2b where it shows most of the (lengthy) derivation by minimizing KL. There are some small parts where it skipped intermediate algebraic derivation steps like in 2b for the Lagrange multipliers but overall the performance was quite strong.
